# Parse: capture movie title lines and their director lines in each block
# Blocks are separated by blank lines; title is first non-empty line starting not with '#'
blocks = [b.strip() for b in content.split('\n\n') if b.strip()]

jackson_titles = []
for b in blocks:
    lines = [ln.strip() for ln in b.split('\n') if ln.strip()]
    if not lines:
        continue
    title = lines[0]
    director_lines = [ln for ln in lines[1:] if ln.lower().startswith('- director:')]
    director = None
    if director_lines:
        director = director_lines[0].split(':',1)[1].strip()
    if director == 'Peter Jackson':
        jackson_titles.append(title)

print('Peter Jackson titles (possibly with duplicates):', jackson_titles)
# Deduplicate while preserving order
seen=set(); unique=[]
for t in jackson_titles:
    if t not in seen:
        seen.add(t); unique.append(t)
print('Unique:', unique)
message_text = ', '.join(unique)
